title: Wedding Wire Top Rating!
author: madwire
excerpt: We are happy to announce that we have once again received a top rating for getting reviews for Denver’s #1 Wedding DJ Service serving the Denver metro,Northern Georgia and Front Range! Thank you to Wedding Wire for the great opportunity and we look forward to many more years and many more reviews!
